summary: The blind compare flagged only 007 (AMBIGUOUS): 适合的房子 is common colloquially, so 我想找一个___的房子 did not force 合适. I rewrote it as 大小正___ with no object, so only the adjective fits. The rest of the review found no wrong keys but fixed unnatural sentences (063 我的感冒一个星期了, 070 看不出来 for handwriting), a proper name the spec does not allow (077 爱迪生), a stiff level-3 sentence (028), weak or incomplete why notes (047, 073, 080), awkward English (039, 043) and one neutral tone (075 走走). Judgement calls left as they are: 037 keeps 觉得 as the distractor against 以为 because 其实 is there; 081 keeps 我是学生以前 as the wrong sentence; 015 relies on the English cue to rule out 没听懂.

near-synonyms-01-007.note: AMBIGUOUS: 适合的房子 is widely accepted. Rewrote as 这套房子大小正___，离地铁站也不远。 With no object, 正适合 fails and 正合适 is forced. Changed to level 2, swapped the option order, and wrote new pinyin, English and why.

near-synonyms-01-028.note: Replaced the stiff 将…并与几家企业见面 (HSK 5+ vocabulary) with 下个月市长要访问日本，跟几家大公司的老板见面。 The key is unchanged.

near-synonyms-01-039.note: The English 'I feel that my head no longer hurts' was unidiomatic.

near-synonyms-01-043.note: The English 'I feel too tired' was unidiomatic.

near-synonyms-01-047.note: The why did not mention the distractor 后来; added it.

near-synonyms-01-063.note: 我的感冒一个星期了 is unnatural; changed to 我感冒一个星期了.

near-synonyms-01-070.note: 看不出来 means 'can't tell' and does not fit illegible writing; changed to 认不出来.

near-synonyms-01-073.note: The why claimed a bare 以后 can only mean 'from now on'. Restated it: 先 calls for 然后.

near-synonyms-01-075.note: Pinyin: reduplicated 走走 takes a neutral tone on the second syllable (zǒu zou).

near-synonyms-01-077.note: 爱迪生 is a proper name the spec does not allow. Replaced with the judge 纸是中国人发现的 -> 发明的 (level 1). It is still a false item.

near-synonyms-01-080.note: The why ('再在 is not a pattern') gave no reason; rewrote it to explain 还在 against 再.
